name: Carmine Gabriele Fiorillo
bioAdditions: The 1840 civil marriage act settles the question of Carmine's mother. When Carmine (34, contadino, born at Savuto) married Giuseppina Ferlaino on 1 March 1840, his parents are given as Domenico Fiorillo and Maria Marrelli, both then living (S1). The church entry two days later notes that the groom came from Aiello (S2). Maria Marrello was buried in 1846 as Domenico's wife (S4). Two sisters, Cintia (Giacinta) and Antonia, born at Aiello Calabro, married at San Mango in 1839 and 1844 with the same parents named (S5). The 1860 death act read in round 3, and the parish burial index (S3), both give his mother as 'Vittoria' Marrelli/Marrello. A Vittoria Marrello was in fact the wife of Francesco Gabriele Fiorillo, very probably Domenico's brother, and mother of Angelo (1824-1912) and Lorenzo (1835-1915). The death informant evidently confused the two Marrello wives. Maria, not Vittoria, was Carmine's mother.

conflicts.siteValue: Vittoria Marrelli (H0345), from the 1860 death act
conflicts.foundValue: Maria Marrelli/Marrello (1840 civil marriage, made while she was alive; her own 1846 burial as wife of Domenico)
conflicts.assessment: Prefer Maria: the marriage act was made during her lifetime with the groom present. Vittoria was the wife of Francesco G. Fiorillo. Merge/remove H0345 and attach Maria Morrello (I282824815353) as mother.
